tool_args.rationale: The target horizon is 24.2, whereas all paid observations have H ≤ 0.48. A slow-horizon probe directly tests the proposed delayed reversal and constrains the slow timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-exponential adaptation model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify the slow component or its long-horizon reversal.
More short-horizon resolution would be less directly informative about the target horizon.
The pilot alone does not establish either mechanism; long-horizon observations can help distinguish the recalled candidates.
It is irrelevant to the identified horizon ambiguity.
